lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁੰਢਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਮਲ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khu(n)dhaa a(n)dar rakh kai den s mal sajaai ||
lines.translation: and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਪੈ ਤੈ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras kas tatar paaeeai tapai tai vilalaai ||
lines.translation: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਫੋਗੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਦਿਚੈ ਅਗਿ ਜਾਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhee so phog samaaleeai dichai ag jaalaai ||
lines.translation: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੈ ਪਤਰੀਐ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mithai patareeai vekhahu lokaa aai ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਸ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa maran na chit aas ghaneriaa ||
lines.translation: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi nit kisai na keriaa ||
lines.translation: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!
In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.
The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਾਰਾਮ ਕਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh loon haaraam kiaa na jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what they have been given.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਧੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਲਾਮ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: badhe karan salaam khasam na bhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach milai mukh naam saahib bhaavasee ||
lines.translation: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.
They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny. ||11||
First Mehl, Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਛੀ ਤਾਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਕਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: machhee taaroo kiaa kare pa(n)khee kiaa aakaas ||
lines.translation: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਸਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pathar paalaa kiaa kare khusare kiaa ghar vaas ||
lines.translation: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਤੇ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕੁਤੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kute cha(n)dan laaeeai bhee so kutee dhaat ||
lines.translation: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠ ॥
lines.transliteration: bolaa je samajhaaeeai paReeahi si(n)mrit paath ||
lines.translation: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਵੇ ਬਲਹਿ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhaa chaanan rakheeai deeve balahi pachaas ||
lines.translation: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਣੇ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਵੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaune suinaa paaeeai chun chun khaavai ghaas ||
lines.translation: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਮਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਢਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: lohaa maaran paaeeai dhahai na hoi kapaas ||
lines.translation: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖ ਏਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak moorakh ehi gun bole sadaa vinaas ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1||
First Mehl:
When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,
the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.
If a husband leaves his wife,
their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.
When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.
When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.
In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.
There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.
When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.
Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.
Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.
The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.
Nanak says this after deep reflection:
through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kudarat saaj kai aape kare beechaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik khote ik khare aape parakhanahaar ||
lines.translation: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਹਰ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khare khajaanai paaeeahi khote sateeahi baahar vaar ||
lines.translation: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: khote sachee daragah suteeahi kis aagai karahi pukaar ||
lines.translation: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-unto whom should they complain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur pichhai bhaj pavahi ehaa karanee saar ||
lines.translation: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਟਿਅਹੁ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur khotiahu khare kare sabad savaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee daragah ma(n)neean gur kai prem piaar ||
lines.translation: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the True Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: ganat tinaa dee ko kiaa kare jo aap bakhase karataar ||12||
lines.translation: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator Lord Himself? ||12||
Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਪੀਰਾ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham jer jimee duneeaa peeraa masaaikaa raaiaa ||
lines.translation: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buried under the ground.
The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||1||
First Mehl:
Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings,
Nor the Siddhas, nor the seekers shall remain on the earth.
Who else is there?
